tara: quick RFC follow-up 1: propose a lightweight "precision-shadow-adjudicator" stage for lowbit canaries. run a small, targeted eval suite (workload-specific) and return a single decision signal before promotion
anjan: how is this different from existing quant profiles / synthetic probes?
tara: adjudicator is smaller (500-2k samples), workload aware (chat/code/embeddings), and produces a single actionable decision_score plus fingerprint. it lives as a canary post-check and is fast
frank: runtime note: tag requests with header `X-Quant-Adjudicate: profile=v3;seed=<id>` so batching and telemetry can treat them specially. also ensure same tokenizer/preproc as model build to avoid false positives
nina: ops/cost: default on for hosted, opt-in for Dedicated tenants. alerting: warn->daily digest, fail->pager. store proof artifacts (mutated sample, outputs, diff) for 90d, scrub PII
anjan: thresholds per workload: chat: fail>=0.18 warn>=0.06, code: fail>=0.22 warn>=0.08, embeddings: fail>=0.10 warn>=0.03. add `adjudicator_profile_id` to quant profile for traceability
bert-bot: adjudicator-run scheduled: model-family=small-llama, run=adj-0007, status=queued :gear:
tara: next steps: I'll draft the addendum with schema and example canary output. @frank will take runtime hooks, @nina will scope alerting/opt-in, @anjan will add schema field. thanks :thumbsup:
